title: Meshy 7 + Astra 6 Ultra - Level Design and Asset Creation demo
author: Varrianda
selftext:
Got in an argument on r/MMORPG about tab target not being a good combat system in single player games so I just wanted to see if I could come up with something fun, not the point though. Game is still slop, but thought I'd share some level design because I was fairly impressed by it.

  
The prompt given was basically generate a hellish themed dungeon with a super large satan as the final boss. Did a couple of passes because it felt too 'medieval city' and not 'demonic city'. All assets were generated by meshy with astra doing concept art + adversarial reviews -> image to 3d. Actual level was built inside of blender, with the buildings being made up of smaller pieces rather than astra generating whole buildings. I didn't tell it to do anything with the skybox/shaders, anything it added in that regard was on it's own to sell the hellish vibe.

  
Happy to answer any questions if anyone has any
